input.summary: Fix the illusory cap quantum in § 21.1: cap becomes the greater of all amounts paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000. As drafted the cap keys to "Fees", which § 1.5 defines as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is effectively USD 12,000 and sits far below six months' actual spend. We have referred to all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and added the USD 1,000,000 floor; mutuality, the indirect-damages exclusion and the Excluded Claims carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, which remain outside the cap) are unchanged.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
